content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge resolves the Isaiah 7:14 link by asking whether the sign verse itself states the mechanism, rather than weighing CR2 and DR3's chains by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the sign itself does not state the mechanism.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires","room":"none","why":"K-C requires chain-against-chain footing when DR3 presses with its own chain, but the judge rests on the sign's own silence about mechanism."}
